job.job_description:
We're looking for an engineer who has built real GenAI appssystems that customers actually use. The kind that combine LLMs, RAG, vector databases, Python backend engineering, and AI agents to solve real business problems at scale.

If you've ever built:

Production RAG Pipelines
AI Agents & Multi-Agent Workflows
LangChain / LangGraph / LlamaIndex applications
FastAPI-based AI services
Semantic Search using Vector Databases
AI solutions on AWS, Azure, or GCP

...then we'd love to talk to you!

Role

Senior AI / Generative AI Engineer

Location: Chennai




You'll work with technologies like:

Python
LLMs (OpenAI, Claude, Llama & more)
RAG & Embeddings
LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex
Pinecone, Weaviate, ChromaDB, FAISS
FastAPI & REST APIs
Docker & Cloud (AWS/Azure/GCP)

Why this role?

Build AI products used by enterprise customers in the US
High ownership and direct collaboration with founders
Work on cutting-edge Agentic AI and production GenAI systems
Opportunity to shape architecture—not just write code
Fast career growth in a product-focused AI company
